Madu Luxury Camp

The Madu camp has 10 tents, all with private bathroom and shower, hot water, electricity and every comfort, in the heart of the desert. An unforgettable experience for the mind and the senses!

Request a booking

Facilities

10 tents with private bathroom, electricity and every comfort.

Activities

You will live a unique experience riding a camel with us and forget all your worries.

Disconnection

We prepare the perfect place for you to rest and relax, a place where you can disconnect.

You reach the camp by dromedary in the late afternoon, in time to watch the sunset from the top of a dune. Dinner under the stars, Berber music around the fire and breakfast with the sunrise over Erg Chebbi.

The camp combines with one or more nights at Riad Madu, at the foot of the dunes, and with any of our routes and excursions.

10tents
100 %private bathroom
1 hby dromedary
